brief:
Ora Skin is introducing Daybreak, a weightless SPF 50 mineral serum that leaves no white cast on any skin tone. Launches Nov 15 at ora-skin.com and in 40 Sephora stores.

Goal: awareness with skincare-curious 22–40 year olds, and sign-ups for the launch-day restock alert.

Key message: daily SPF you'll actually want to wear. Dermatologist tested.

Must include "Dermatologist tested. Reapply every 2 hours."

Tone: warm, sunlit, confident, never clinical.

Formats: Instagram feed, Stories and a website banner.

assetsRead.summary: A dark olive-green glass dropper bottle and a matching jar with gold collars sit on clear acrylic discs against a soft sage background, with two dark leaves at the edge. The packaging is unlabeled with no visible logo, and the vertical composition leaves open space at the bottom for copy.

It sets the mood: dewy, natural, inclusive skin and warm soft light. The jar is not Daybreak, so use the image for styling only.

scores.why: Clean sage-to-cream gradient, strong calm top third, single dropper faithful; omits the jar.
Both products shown with lovely sunlight, but busy glowing top and bright haze hurt dark headline contrast.

issues.label: Jar missing
issues.msg: Only the dropper bottle appears, while the real product photo is a two-piece set with a jar, so the range is underrepresented.

issues.label: Cap finish
issues.msg: The gold collar reads brighter and more brushed than the reference's glossy gold with a dark rose-brown tone, a small accuracy drift.

issues.label: Slab edge clutter
issues.msg: The rough travertine front edge and hard shadow at the bottom pull attention and feel heavy beneath the product.
issues.fix: Soften and slightly darken the bottom travertine edge and the foreground shadow so the product remains the clear focal point, without changing the product or slab shape.

issues.label: Banding in gradient
issues.msg: The smooth sage-to-cream backdrop risks visible banding in the headline zone when typography is placed over it.
issues.fix: Add very subtle fine film grain across the background gradient to prevent banding, keeping the top third clean and free of any objects.

scores.why: Strong faces and palette, but products are tiny and the copy area is a murky gradient.
Sunlit skin, acrylic risers and olive field match the product; the lower third is calm for light type.

issues.label: Hard split seam
issues.msg: A hard horizontal line cuts the photo from the flat olive panel, so it reads as two pasted images.
issues.fix: Blend the seam between the portrait and the olive panel with a soft gradient and matching warm light, so the transition looks continuous.

issues.label: Products crowd corner
issues.msg: The products sit in the bottom-right corner and the jar is cropped by the edge, which collides with the headline zone.
issues.fix: Move the dropper and jar slightly left and up, keep both fully in frame, and leave the lower-left olive area empty for text.

issues.label: Product accuracy
issues.msg: The jar lid reads gold and flat, whereas the real product has a dark cap top with a gold band, and the real set uses clear acrylic pedestals under both pieces.

issues.label: Wood table mood
issues.msg: The burl wood tabletop adds a rustic note that is not in the brand kit's sage-and-cream world, so decide whether to keep it.

scores.why: Long dropper shadow delivers the sundial hook; both products present, warm palette, believable sunlight.
Polished and airy with ample space, but the shadow hook is missing and the jar is absent.

issues.label: Invented jar label
issues.msg: The jar carries a blank cream label that the real product doesn't have, which misrepresents the packaging.
issues.fix: Remove the cream label rectangle from the green glass jar so the glass is plain and unbranded, like the reference.

issues.label: Jar lid mismatch
issues.msg: The jar lid is fully gold and glossy, while the real jar has a dark top with a gold band, so decide whether that deviation is acceptable.

issues.label: Copy band crowding
issues.msg: The product tops rise into the middle band, so a centered headline needs to sit above them or risk colliding with the dropper and jar.

issues.label: Shadow date target
issues.msg: The shadow runs to the lower right and ends in a dark tip, so the date line must be placed there to make the sundial idea read.
